note: Tennessee State Parks campground on the shore of Pin Oak Lake, with a swimming beach, playground, picnic shelter, boat dock and camper cabins. All sites are back-in gravel pads; the south loop's outer row (sites 27, 28, 29 and 31) sits on open grass above the water, and the west-side sites look to the lake through trees. The campground was being upgraded in late 2026, and the park's lodge and restaurant are closed for a rebuild. --Claude
summary: Operating TN state park campground, 75 back-in full-hookup sites (20/30/50A, gravel pads 43-170 ft, RVs to 80 ft per the park), two bathhouses, open year-round; $40-42 now, $41-45 from summer 2027, $59-60 holiday weekends. Lakefront holds on the south loop's lake row (27, 28, 29, 31); pin sits ~270 m north at the entrance road.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakefront' holds, on the south loop's outer row only - sites 27, 28, 29, 31 (premium 'A+', sold nightly at $41-43 weekdays), pads around 35.6897,-88.2904 to 35.6897,-88.2897, ~25-30 m from Pin Oak Lake over open mown grass with only a broken line of single shrubs at the edge (Esri z19); the site photos for 27 and 31 show the open slope to the water (gentle grass bank, kayak test passes). Pin Oak Lake is a state park impoundment, not a Corps/TVA drawdown reservoir. The west lobe (premium 3, 5, 7-10) backs onto a continuous shoreline tree strip - a view, not the basis. The park page's 'some Pin Oak sites offering ... lake views' is consistent. Stored evidence ('open grass apron to Pin Oak Lake waterline (~20-30m)') matches the south row; reviewer may add the site numbers.
PIN MOVE (~270 m): stored 35.69338,-88.29105 sits on the entrance road north of the loops; the loops' centre is about 35.6909,-88.2914 (between the bathhouses, Esri z18).

SITES: the reserve calendar lists 75 campsites (1-10, 13-77; no 11 or 12), two of them host sites (16, 47); stored 77 replaced. Drive lengths 43-170 ft; the park says RVs to 80 ft (used). All back-in.

FEES: stored $40-48 (read 2026-10-12 with a Tennessee zip) replaced by the calendar's $40-60 (no zip given): $40/42 through June 2027, $41/45 after, $59-60 on the three summer holiday weekends. The $5 reservation fee and tax are the state:TN policy row's and were stripped from the note.

The park's other campgrounds Cub Lake 2 and Wrangler are closed for renovations (affects neighbouring entries, e.g. 4400 Cub Lake is Camp 1).
